description: Source file implementing the SystemInfo class and related components for system information management within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class providing system information and notification management.

classes.description: Handles network-related information such as IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Contains location details such as timezone, country, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Represents device identifier details including architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

methods.description: Registers a notification client for system info updates.

methods.description: Triggers an update of system information and notifies clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RecursiveList
methods.description: Recursively calls notifications for all registered clients.
